scan_linter_check.description:
Reports each function whose cyclomatic complexity is above the system property ecs.complexity.max (default 10). Complexity is 1 + the decision points in the function's own body: if, ?:, each non-default case, for, for-in, while, do-while, catch, && and ||. Nested functions are scored separately and do not add to the enclosing function; code outside any function is scored as "top-level code".
Applies to every scanned script, server- and client-side. This is a maintainability signal, not a defect: high complexity makes code harder to test, review and change safely.
scan_linter_check.name: SN-COMPLEXITY-001: Excessive function complexity
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Split the function into smaller functions with one responsibility each, replace long if/else or switch chains with lookup tables, and return early instead of nesting. Adjust the limit with the system property ecs.complexity.max if the default does not suit your standard.
scan_linter_check.short_description: A function's cyclomatic complexity is above the configured limit (default 10).
